Narrator: Our tale begins in a world where memories themselves have become the most valuable form of currency. Memories that can be traded, bartered, and, most dangerously, stolen. In this society, our young protagonist, Aria finds herself. Her eyes mirroring the grey, weary hues of the city around her.
Narrator: Aria speaks to herself, her voice echoing through an empty room, walls lined with countless Memory Chambers — machines used to extract and install memories.
Aria: I have to get them back.
Narrator: A knock echoes through the room, interrupting Aria’s thoughts. The door swings open to reveal a tall figure with hair as dark as the city skyline. This is Elias — a memory trader.
Elias: Heard you lost somethin' precious, Aria. I might be able to help you get it back.
Aria: You can? Are you... a memory trader.
Narrator: He flashes a memory Analyst ID, its holographic surface glinting in the dim light.
Aria: I need my childhood memories, Elias. They were taken from me...
Elias: And you want them back. Figured as much.

Narrator: Their eyes meet in a mutual understanding. The first steps of their journey have been set in motion. Unbeknownst to them, however, the ruthless memory broker — Madam Vivance — has caught wind of their efforts.
